title: Console reads and edits `form` items: Setup public forms re-pointed, the PR #36784 designer becomes the `form` editor in Studio (ADR-0159, card ③)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Source: ADR-0159 (PR #36957), decision D9 and the Execution plan. Parent: #36868, card ③ of five. Carries the paused work of #36444 and draft PR #36784.

Blocked-by: #37086
Metadata-protocol: none
Clause-②: no
(Seat note: re-read at claim. New editor keys in an exported language pack are `yes`; the removed Studio navigation key `apps.studio.navigation.nav_public_forms.label` is a narrowing.)

Grading: `area:build` · Feature · the console reads and edits `form` items; public forms are designed through the `form` type · builders and administrators · evidence: ADR-0159 D9's table, read at `main` `62692b7f8b`. p1.

## What to build

1. **Setup, Configuration, Public forms** (merged in #36697): re-point from `view` to `form`. The list read in the page and the six type arguments in the Setup data module (the two layered reads, the two save paths, the reset, the override save) name `form`; the row reader takes the item itself, with no `viewKind` filter and no `config` hop. Behaviour is unchanged: every public form listed, on and off, copy address, preview, switched-off forms stay listed. A switch written before this card (a `view` override) is found and cleared by the re-pointed switch, through card ②'s write rule. The page's judgement of an app's own document reads the `form` per-package layer, not the stored container (ADR-0159 D6 rule 6). Switching on a form whose address another form holds is refused by the server (ruled question 3, judged at every `form` save that leaves the form open): the page shows the refusal with both names and leaves the form off. Setup stays without field editing, create and delete (ruling record 7100386248, items 6 to 10).
2. **The designer of PR #36784** becomes the `form` type's editor in Studio: its design module, its component and their tests are kept; its read and write move from a view item's `config` to the `form` item, whose body is at the top level (ADR-0159 ruled question 5). Its rules stay: fillable fields only, an object-required field cannot be removed, the address clash message (now the early message in front of card ②'s server refusal, ruled question 3; the designer shows the server's refusal when its own check missed), draft then publish, an installed app's form saved as a declared override in the app's `.custom` pair.
   - **The designer has no switch.** It reads the effective `form` item (the override when one stands, ⛔ not the base's body) and writes `sharing.enabled` and `sharing.allowAnonymous` back as it read them. Its save is a whole-document override at the `(pair, name)` Setup's switch-only override sits at (ADR-0159 D4), so a publish built from the base's body would replace a switch-off with an open form. ⛔ A publish from the designer never opens a form Setup switched off (Studio designs, Setup operates: ruling record 7100386248).
3. **Do not land** the Form-tab switch PR #36784 adds to the Studio design surface. The object page's field-layout tab stays field groups only.
4. **Studio's metadata list for `form`**: the columns row (name, label, object, public address, on or off; where `label` is absent the row shows `title`, then the name), create, delete, Source, layered view, history and rollback, draft and publish, the "customization" and "overrides" marks. This card adds the `form` resource's client `listColumns` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/registry.ts`. The served columns row is #36860's: if it has landed, name the `form` row as a follow-up there; ⛔ this card adds no spec row.
5. **Retire** Studio Developer, Public Forms: the page (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/PublicFormsPage.tsx`), its tests, and the `nav_public_forms` entry of the Studio app (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/studio.app.ts`) with its translations and source hashes; the old route redirects to the `form` list. ⛔ Setup's navigation entry carries the same id (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts`) and stays. Three pins name the id and are updated with the removal, each still asserting Setup's entry: `packages/cli/test/connect-agent-both-halves-wire.pin.test.ts`, `packages/cli/test/console-page-nav-entries.pin.test.ts`, `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/console-page-nav-entries.test.ts`.
6. **`FormPage`**: the internal route reads `GET /api/v1/meta/form/NAME`; the anonymous route is unchanged (it reads the server's resolution).
7. Business wording on every surface, no internal names.

## Done when

- The acceptance list of ruling record 7100386248 on #36444 passes on `examples/app-showcase`, driven in a browser, with two public forms: the old-shape `showcase_inquiry.contact` (served through card ②'s projection, the state every first-party form is in until card ④) and the `form` item card ② added. Each step below is run on the old-shape form at least once:
  - an administrator sees Public forms in Setup and an ordinary member does not;
  - both public forms listed with title, object and address;
  - switch one off: its address shows not-found without signing in and takes no submission; on again: restored; it stays listed while off;
  - in Studio, edit a shipped form (make a field required, remove one, change the title), publish: the change shows anonymously and the required field is enforced;
  - create a public form with four fields at a new address, publish: it takes a submission and the record appears;
  - a taken address is refused with a clear message, in the designer and at Setup's switch-on; removing an object-required field is refused with its reason.
- Switch a form off in Setup, then edit and publish it in Studio: its address still answers not-found without signing in and takes no submission, and Setup still shows it off (one test and one browser check; ablate: build the designer's save from the base's body).
- An action of type `form` opens its form after the re-point (one live check and one test).
- No console surface reads a form's definition from `view`: the form page, Setup's page and data module, and the editor read `form`. The PR lists the remaining hits of `git grep -nE "formViews|viewKind: 'form'|viewKind === 'form'" -- ui ':!**/CHANGELOG.md'` with the reason each stays. ⛔ Keep the branch in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx` that keeps `viewKind: 'form'` items out of the list switcher, and the `view` editor's form arm under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`: `GET /api/v1/meta/view` lists those items until major 19 (ADR-0159 D5), and the major-19 card removes both.
- The removed page, navigation entry and tests are listed in the PR body; screenshots of Setup's list, the Studio list and the editor are attached.
- The PR body says `Fixes` for #36444 only if the seat confirms it at claim.

## Not in this card

- No spec schema or server behaviour change. A gap found there goes back to card ② as a report. In scope outside `ui/`: item 5's entry, translations, source hashes and three pins under `packages/platform-objects` and `packages/cli/test`, with a `patch` changeset on each released package the diff moves.
- No tombstone (card ⑤).

Dedupe words: public forms setup re-point, form editor Studio, PublicFormsPage retire, FormPage meta form.
